data.title: MARA Holdings (MARA) Mined More Bitcoin, but Revenue Fell 27%
data.description: MARA Holdings (NASDAQ:MARA) mined 2,422 bitcoin in the second quarter, a little more than it mined a year earlier. Yet revenue fell 27% to $174.9 million because the average price of each coin it produced was far lower. That gap explains why the company wants to stop being known as a bitcoin miner. It now […]
